name: pamonteiro84-plugins
description: Personal plugin marketplace for Claude Code

plugins.name: claude-mem
plugins.description: Persistent memory across Claude Code sessions: captures what the agent does, compresses it with AI, and injects the relevant context back into future sessions.

plugins.name: task-observer
plugins.description: Meta-skill that watches work sessions and logs opportunities to create or improve other skills (One Skill to Rule Them All).

plugins.name: omniroute
plugins.description: AI gateway that unifies 352 providers (Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, ...) with automatic fallback and token compression, exposed to Claude Code as an MCP server.
